scenario: Rule-level cooldown (LGRA.6.6 / RLOW.4.6) suppresses subsequent calls within the cooldown window for the same binding-tuple. Uses TTL schema so each assert is a fresh fact (logical would dedup), `by: t.v` because a `ttl` fact has no declared identity (LCDB.3.3.4), and the same `v` value so the cooldown key matches across activations.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope ttl 1_h:
    v: Int

service svc.x:
    "stub service for conformance"
    no response

rule r cooldown 30_s by: t.v:
    Trig t
->
    call svc.x nocooldown
